# Composition

## Rules
- One factory per domain UC; constructors not on `index.ts`. Config I/O: `createDefaultConfigLoader`/`createConfigWriter` return ports directly — no pass-through UC wrappers.
- Public shapes: `createX(deps)` canonical (no fs paths); `createX(config, options?)` via resolver + `resolveXDeps` helper. Options only on config form; invalid → `InvalidCompositionFactoryArgumentsError`.
- `CompositionResolver`: session-scoped, lazy, cacheable; no per-UC `XDeps` knowledge.
- Registry/view/capability-merge primitives composition-owned; kernel reuses as facade.
- Internal port impls not on `"."`; contracts on `"./ports"`; factories return port types.
- VCS/actor via auto-detect factories; rootPath derived data not full adapter when port only needs root.
- `FsChangeRepositoryOptions`: `artifactTypes` and/or `resolveArtifactTypes` (lazy cache); neither → sync no-op.
- `createKernel(config)` mounts all UCs by domain; approvals under `kernel.changes`. Optional; standalone factories OK. Fluent `createKernelBuilder` ≡ same `KernelOptions` model.
- `ConfigLoader`/`ConfigWriter` application ports; hosts use factory wrappers — never construct `Fs*` directly. `createConfigWriter()` / `createConfigWriter(options)` public.
- `createKernel` MUST NOT wire ConfigWriter/InitProject/AddPlugin/RemovePlugin.
- `SpecdConfig` plain typed object in domain/application; has `schemaPlugins`, `schemaOverrides` — not `artifactRules`/`workflow`.
- Spec repo construction: use absolute `metadataPath` from adapter when present; else derive (VCS walk) — loader MUST NOT invent path.
- `createResolveSchema` wires SchemaRegistry + schema ref + workspace schemas + plugins + overrides; `createGetActiveSchema` uses it.
- Hosts bootstrap via `@specd/sdk`; CLI/MCP depend on sdk only for platform packages.
- Public barrels: `"."`=`public.ts`, `"./ports"`, `"./extensions"`, `"./internal"`=`index.ts`. `"."` no `export *` from domain/application/composition.
- `"."` exports Kernel, UC types, Input/Result, createX factories, port types (not impls), repo factories with adapter-id first arg (`'fs'` builtin).
- Provide `*Deps`/`resolve*Deps`/`createX` for metadata materialization + persisted-state UCs; MUST NOT export Save/Update/InvalidateSpecMetadata or public PersistSpecMetadata.
- `./extensions`: storage factories, CompositionRegistry*, KernelBuilder, providers, ExternalHookRunner, RegistryConflictError. No code-graph registration.

## Constraints
- Only `composition/` may import `infrastructure/`.
- Concrete adapters never on public entry points.
- Repo + kernel-mounted createX factories on `"."`.
- Kernel namespaces by domain area.
- Monorepo-only symbols on `"./internal"`.
